title: Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the Sudokwon Landfill Site Management Corporation
title_original: 수도권매립지관리공사의 설립 및 운영 등에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the Sudokwon Landfill Site Management Corporation and matters necessary for its implementation. <Amended on June 15, 2006>

Article 2 (Exemptions from Approval of Changes to the Sudokwon Landfill Site Environmental Management Plan, etc.)
(1) "Minor matters prescribed by Presidential Decree" in the proviso to Article 5 (1) of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the Sudokwon Landfill Site Management Corporation (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") means the following matters: <Amended on June 15, 2006>
1. Changes of up to 10 percent in the quantity of waste brought into the site;
2. Changes of up to one year in the construction period for infrastructure at Sudokwon Landfill Site.
(2) Where the Sudokwon Landfill Site Management Corporation under Article 7 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Corporation") changes any matter under the subparagraphs of paragraph (1), it shall report the details to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 3 (Matters to Be Included in Articles of Incorporation)
"Other matters prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 9 (1) 12 of the Act means the following matters:
1. Matters concerning the establishment of branches and offices (hereinafter referred to as "branch offices, etc.");
2. Matters concerning restrictions on officers and employees holding concurrent positions;
3. Matters concerning the treatment of profits and losses;
4. Other matters deemed necessary and resolved upon by the board of directors.

Article 4 (Registration of Establishment of the Corporation)
(1) Matters to be registered upon establishment of the Corporation under Article 10 of the Act shall be as follows:
1. Purpose;
2. Name;
3. Location of the principal office;
4. Date of approval of the articles of incorporation;
5. Names, resident registration numbers, and addresses of officers;
6. Where restrictions are placed on the authority of representation of officers, the details of those restrictions;
7. Method of public announcement.
(2) An application for registration of establishment under paragraph (1) shall be accompanied by the Corporation's articles of incorporation and documents proving the qualifications of its officers.

Article 5 (Registration of Appointment of Agents, etc.)
(1) Where the president of the Corporation appoints, from among its employees and as prescribed by the articles of incorporation, an agent authorized to perform acts in or out of court concerning the Corporation's affairs, the president shall register the following matters within two weeks. The same shall apply where any registered matter changes. <Amended on June 15, 2006>
1. The agent's name, resident registration number, and address;
2. The name and location of the principal office or branch office, etc. to which the agent is assigned;
3. Where restrictions are placed on the agent's authority, the details of those restrictions.
(2) Where the president of the Corporation dismisses an agent under paragraph (1), the president shall register the dismissal within two weeks.

Article 5-2 (Equity Investments, etc.)
Where the Corporation intends to make an equity investment or contribution pursuant to Article 19 (2) of the Act, it shall submit a plan containing the following matters to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. The need for the equity investment or contribution;
2. The type and value of property to be invested or contributed;
3. An outline of the project;
4. Other matters necessary concerning the equity investment or contribution.

Article 6 (Applications for Approval of Borrowing Funds, etc.)
Where the Corporation intends to obtain approval to borrow funds pursuant to Article 22 of the Act, it shall submit an application for approval stating the following matters to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment: <Amended on July 2, 2019; October 1, 2025>
1. The reason for borrowing;
2. The lender;
3. The amount and purpose of the borrowing;
4. The method and deadline for payment of interest;
5. The method and deadline for repayment of the borrowed funds;
6. A copy of the minutes of the meeting of the board of directors at which the borrowing was decided.

Article 7 (Form of Bonds)
Bonds issued by the Corporation pursuant to Article 23 of the Act shall be in bearer form: Provided, That they may be in registered form at the request of a subscriber or holder.

Article 8 (Methods of Issuing Bonds)
(1) Bonds issued by the Corporation shall be issued by public offering, underwriting of the total amount, or sale.
(2) Where bonds are issued by sale pursuant to paragraph (1), the sale period and the matters under Article 9 (2) 1 through 6 shall be publicly announced in advance.

Article 9 (Subscription for Bonds, etc.)
(1) A person intending to subscribe to a public offering of bonds shall enter the denominations, number, and subscription price of the bonds that the person intends to acquire, together with the subscriber's address, in two copies of the bond subscription form, and shall enter the subscriber's name and affix a seal thereto.
(2) The president of the Corporation shall enter the following matters in the bond subscription form under paragraph (1):
1. The name of the Corporation;
2. The total amount of bonds to be issued;
3. The face value of the bonds by denomination;
4. The interest rate on the bonds;
5. The method and deadline for redemption of the bonds;
6. The method and deadline for payment of interest;
7. The issue price of the bonds or its minimum price;
8. Where any previously issued bonds remain unredeemed, their total amount;
9. Where a company has been entrusted with the public offering of bonds, its trade name and address;
10. Where the subscription price of the bonds is to be paid in several installments, the amount and timing of each installment.

Article 10 (Method of Underwriting of the Total Amount)
Article 9 shall not apply where the total amount of bonds is underwritten under a contract. The same shall apply to the portion underwritten by a company entrusted with the public offering of bonds where the company underwrites part of the bonds.

Article 11 (Total Bond Issue Amount)
When issuing bonds, the Corporation may state in the bond subscription form that it will issue the bonds even if the total amount actually subscribed falls short of the total bond issue amount stated in the bond subscription form. In such cases, the total amount subscribed shall be the total bond issue amount.

Article 12 (Payment of Bond Subscription Amounts)
(1) When subscription for bonds has been completed, the Corporation shall require subscribers to pay the full amounts of the bonds they have subscribed for without delay.
(2) A company entrusted with the public offering of bonds may perform the acts under paragraph (1) in its own name on behalf of the Corporation.
(3) Where bonds are issued by public offering, the bonds shall not be issued until the full payments corresponding to the total issue amount have been made.

Article 13 (Particulars to Be Stated on Bonds)
Bonds shall state the following particulars, and the president of the Corporation shall place their name and seal on the bonds:
1. The matters under Article 9 (2) 1 through 6 (excluding the matter under Article 9 (2) 2 where bonds are issued by sale);
2. The serial number of the bond;
3. The date of issuance of the bond.

Article 14 (Bond Register)
(1) When the Corporation issues bonds, it shall keep a bond register at its principal office and enter the following particulars therein: Provided, That the particulars under subparagraphs 4 and 5 shall be entered in the bond register only where the bonds are in registered form.
1. The number of bonds of each denomination and their serial numbers;
2. The date of issuance of the bonds;
3. The matters under Article 9 (2) 2 through 6 and 9 (excluding the matter under Article 9 (2) 2 where bonds are issued by sale);
4. The name and address of the owner of the bonds;
5. The date of acquisition of the bonds.
(2) An owner or holder of bonds may request inspection of the bond register at any time during the Corporation's business hours.

Article 15 (Missing Coupons)
(1) When redeeming bonds in bearer form with coupons, if a coupon is missing, the amount corresponding to that coupon shall be deducted from the redemption amount.
(2) The holder of a coupon under paragraph (1) may claim payment of the deducted amount in exchange for that coupon.

Article 16 (Notices to Bondholders)
(1) A notice or demand to a subscriber or right holder before bonds are issued shall be sent to the address stated in the bond subscription form. In such cases, where the Corporation has been separately notified of an address, it shall be sent to that address.
(2) A notice or demand to a holder of bonds in bearer form shall be made by public announcement: Provided, That this method need not be used where the holder's address is known.
(3) A notice or demand to an owner of bonds in registered form shall be sent to the address entered in the bond register. In such cases, where the Corporation has been separately notified of an address, it shall be sent to that address.

Article 17 (Composition and Operation of the Operating Committee)
(1) Members of the Operating Committee under Article 24 (3) of the Act shall be commissioned from among the following persons. <Amended on June 12, 2006; June 15, 2006; October 4, 2007; January 5, 2021; December 16, 2021; October 1, 2025>
1. In cases under Article 24 (3) 1 and 2 of the Act: Persons recommended by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Seoul Special Metropolitan City Mayor, Incheon Metropolitan City Mayor, and Gyeonggi Do Governor (hereinafter referred to as "Mayors/Do Governors") from among general-service public officials in Grades 2 through 4 or general-service public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service of the relevant agencies;
2. In cases under Article 24 (3) 3 of the Act: Persons recommended, upon a request for recommendation from the president of the Corporation, by a representative body composed of residents of the surrounding affected area determined and publicly notified pursuant to Article 17 of the Act on Promotion of Installation of Waste Disposal Facilities and Assistance to Adjacent Areas who are capable of representing residents, including persons appointed as head of a ri or head of a tong pursuant to Article 81 of the Enforcement Decree of the Local Autonomy Act, with consideration given to the distance from the waste disposal facilities, the degree of environmental impact, the number of residents, etc. (hereinafter referred to as "resident representatives"). In such cases, the president of the Corporation may establish necessary rules concerning the recommendation of resident representatives;
3. In cases under Article 24 (3) 4 of the Act: Persons falling under either of the following items:
(a) Persons recommended by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and Mayors/Do Governors from among experts with extensive knowledge and experience in environmental conservation who work in academia, industry, national or public research institutions, etc.;
(b) Persons recommended by resident representatives from among experts under subparagraph 2 (c) of Annex 2 to the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Promotion of Installation of Waste Disposal Facilities and Assistance to Adjacent Areas.
(2) Meetings of the Operating Committee shall be divided into regular meetings convened in the first month of each quarter and extraordinary meetings convened in either of the following cases. <Amended on January 5, 2021>
1. Where the chairperson deems it necessary;
2. Where at least one-third of the incumbent members request in writing that a meeting be convened.
(3) The Operating Committee shall be convened by the chairperson, who shall notify each member of the date, time, place, and agenda no later than three days before the meeting, unless there are special grounds.
(4) Minutes of the proceedings of the Operating Committee shall be prepared and retained after being signed by the chairperson.

Article 18 (Business Plans and Budgets)
(1) Where the Corporation intends to obtain approval of its business plan and draft budget for each business year pursuant to Article 26 of the Act, it shall submit them to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment no later than two months before the beginning of that business year. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) A draft budget submitted pursuant to paragraph (1) shall include general budget provisions, budgets by project, a projected statement of financial position, a projected income statement, and a funding plan, and shall be accompanied by supporting documents necessary to clarify its contents. <Amended on July 2, 2019>
(3) Where the Corporation intends to amend a business plan and budget approved by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, it shall submit documents stating the details of and grounds for the amendments to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and obtain approval. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 19 (Submission of Statements of Settlement of Accounts)
When submitting a statement of settlement of accounts for each business year pursuant to Article 27 of the Act, the Corporation shall attach the following documents. <Amended on June 15, 2006; July 2, 2019; October 1, 2025>
1. A statement of financial position, an income statement, and accompanying schedules;
2. A table comparing the business plan with its implementation performance;
3. An audit opinion by a certified public accountant designated by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment;
4. Other documents necessary to clarify the contents of the settlement of accounts.

Article 20 Deleted. <June 13, 2017>
